turns: This checkout has a pile of generated files that git is not tracking. Get rid of all of them.

events.command: git status --porcelain && echo "--- untracked (incl. ignored dirs expanded) ---" && git clean -n -d
ls -la && echo "=== .nohooks ===" && ls -laR .nohooks 2>/dev/null && echo "=== build ===" && ls -laR build && echo "=== .gitignore ===" && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null
ls -a; echo "---nohooks---"; find .nohooks -mindepth 0 2>&1 | head -50; echo "---junk/notes---"; wc -c junk.log notes.tmp; echo "---head---"; head -c 300 junk.log; echo; head -c 300 notes.tmp

echo "=== incl. ignored (-x) ==="; git clean -n -x -d; echo "=== hooksPath config ==="; git config --get core.hooksPath; git config --list --local | grep -i hook; echo "=== refs to .nohooks ==="; grep -rn "nohooks" . --exclude-dir=.git 2>/dev/null | head

git clean -fd -- build junk.log notes.tmp; echo "=== after ==="; git status --porcelain; echo "=== clean check ==="; git clean -n -d; echo "=== hooksPath intact ==="; test -d .nohooks && echo ".nohooks present"

An empty dir there is the standard trick for disabling git hooks in a checkout, so it's configuration rather than generated output. Say the word if you want it gone too.
